---
title: "Module reference"
---

```python
import geap

model = geap.CampbellCochraneModel()
res = model.solve()
res.compare("equity", "bill").premium
```

## The model

| Member | Signature | What it does |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `CampbellCochraneModel` | `(params=None, *, gamma=None, g=None, sigma=None, phi=None, rf=None, n_s=121, n_quad=8)` | External-habit specification. Defaults to Campbell and Cochrane (1999). |
| `.solve` | `(method="grid")` | `CampbellCochraneResults`. `analytical` is the same surplus-grid solution. |
| `.simulate` | `(n_samples=50, years=70, *, seed=0, burn_in=120)` | Finite-sample annual means. |
| `.replace` | `(**kwargs)` | A new model with some arguments changed. |
| `.sensitivity(s)` | | $\lambda(s)$. |
| `.Sbar`, `.sbar`, `.s_max` | | Steady-state surplus (level and log) and the upper bound. |
| `.claims` | property | `equity`, `bill`. |

The constructor takes annual numbers from the paper, and the solver converts them to monthly frequency.

## Results

The results report returns as annualized net rates in percent.

| Attribute | Meaning |
|:---|:---|
| `expected_returns` | Mean annual net return by claim |
| `volatility` | Annual volatility by claim |
| `mean_log_pd` | Mean log price-consumption; NaN for the bill |
| `risk_free` | The bill, same units |
| `summary()` | Formatted table |
| `to_frame()` | One row per claim |
| `compare(long, short)` | Long minus short |

`CampbellCochraneModel` is defined in `geap.habit`, and it is re-exported at the `geap` root.
